# UPDATED_MODEL

This directory contains the planning and code artifacts for the Temporal-Valid KG RAG System.

## Structure

- **planning/** - All planning documentation (architecture, design, implementation plans)
- **code/** - All code files including the main entry point

## Main Entry Point

The main entry point for the system is:
```
code/IMPLEMENTATION/main.py
```

This script starts the FastAPI server for the temporal-valid knowledge graph RAG system.

## Documentation

See the `planning/` directory for detailed documentation including:
- Architecture overview
- API contracts
- Implementation plans
- Testing documentation
